data_volume.reached_rule_note: Paired bootstrap over (subset seed, sampler seed) for the per-fraction mean relative reconstruction. A fraction is reached only if the CI lower bound clears T_d minus the control noise width (half the baseline f=1 CI width, unless overridden in control_noise_width). A crossing interval is inconclusive.

privacy.note: Privacy cannot be disabled; every candidate dataset x fraction x subset seed x sampler seed must set privacy_passed=true.
